scenes.headline: How a small vision model learned to read screens
scenes.sub: Liquid's LFM2.5-VL-3B: a compressed vision path and no reasoning step.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dahlia! Liquid's new vision-language model has just over three billion parameters and fits on a phone. Here's how it sees, and why it's fast.

scenes.label: The design
scenes.text: Keep the image small and answer directly: four vision tokens become one, and there's no reasoning step before the answer.
scenes.say: The design: keep the image small, and answer directly. Four vision tokens become one, and the model never stops to reason before replying.

steps.say: A high-resolution image is cut into tiles plus one global thumbnail. A SigLIP2 encoder reads them at their native aspect ratio.
PixelUnshuffle and a small MLP then compress the result. Four encoder tokens become one model token.
Those few tokens join the text prompt, and the model answers directly. On a five-frame clip, the first token lands in about thirty-four milliseconds.

scenes.title: How the grounding got there
scenes.say: Most of the gain came from data and training.

items.text: Same base as the text model
items.say: It starts from Liquid's text model base, pretrained on about thirty-four trillion tokens.
Vision pretraining grew four times in tokens, including synthetic grounding data, which Liquid credits for the grounding gain.
Then fine-tuning from a larger teacher, a step called Antidoom training, and reinforcement learning on several rewards.

scenes.label: ScreenSpot-v2 average: the previous release, then this one
scenes.note: the old model could not ground UI elements at all
scenes.say: The result: on ScreenSpot-v2, the old model scored five point four. It couldn't find a button at all. This one scores eighty point seven.

scenes.text: Skipping reasoning is a trade: it costs STEM accuracy, and buys the speed an agent tapping a screen needs.
scenes.say: Skipping reasoning is a trade. It costs accuracy on STEM questions, and buys the speed an agent needs to look, tap, and look again.

recap: Tiles and a thumbnail through SigLIP2
Four vision tokens compressed into one
No reasoning step, so first tokens come fast
scenes.say: To recap: native-aspect tiles, four tokens into one, and answers without a reasoning detour.
